name: Prisons
overview: Scripture presents prisons as places of confinement where the king's prisoners were bound, often under strict supervision as seen in Joseph's experience (Genesis 39:20-23). Despite the severity of imprisonment, God's presence and favor can bring mercy and prosperity even in such dire circumstances. Prisons were associated with the authority of the house of the captain of the guard and the keeper, who managed the prisoners and their conditions (Genesis 40:3), highlighting both the human and divine dynamics at work within this institution.
